blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Riyadh services operated by flag carrier Philippine Airlines (PAL) will remain suspended until Oct. 11 amid ongoing fighting in the Middle East that has damaged King Khalid International Airport and other Saudi gateways. Earlier, PAL suspended the route, both the Riyadh-bound flight and a return service to Manila, only on Oct. 8.
